Subject: Partner-led discovery — next steps

Hi Marissa & Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro call today — good to align on where CloudBridge and Redwood could partner on the Cloud Marketplace integration. Quick recap from our side:
- CloudBridge expected timeline: Q1 2027 limited rollout, GA by end of Q1.
- Primary integration: Marketplace listing + SSO for procurement flow.
- Technical touchpoints: API keys + an endpoint for usage batching.

We think the next best step is a technical deep dive/demo with your engineering lead to cover integration points and the operational playbook. Are any of these windows viable?
- Wed, Dec 9: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Dec 10: 14:00–15:00 PT
- Fri, Dec 11: 09:00–10:00 PT

If those don't work, send a few alternatives and we can coordinate with our partners team. I attached a draft agenda and the technical requirements doc for reference.

Cheers,
Elena Morris
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge
elena@cloudbridge.io
(415) 555-0198
